{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in the early 30-day horizon, showing a persistent downward bias that corrects as the forecast horizon extends",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.33) correlates with actual price being higher than forecasts, especially in the first 15-day range",
    "When sentiment turns negative ( <0), actual prices lag behind the forecast recovery more than modeled",
    "The divergence between model and true outcomes increases through days 11-20, suggesting momentum is harder to forecast than level",
    "Days 21-30 show better alignment suggesting mean-reversion effects become stronger in that horizon",
    "When history has been volatile (high std dev), the bias between model and truth increases by approximately 0.3-0.5 units",
    "Sentiment magnitude matters: stronger positive sentiment ( >0.67) predicts outsized price increases beyond what the model captures"
] }
